episodes.title: Capítulo 1
episodes.summary: Carolina discovers betrayal and moves with Arlete to SP

episodes.title: Capítulo 2
episodes.summary: Guilherme seduces Angel and the two stay together at the party

episodes.title: Capítulo 3
episodes.summary: Fanny reveals to Angel how the pink book works

episodes.title: Capítulo 1
episodes.summary: Angel becomes Guilherme's widow. Indebted and with a child to raise, she returns to the modeling agency. Giovanna shows up at her house to confront her about Alex's death.

episodes.title: Capitulo 2
episodes.summary: Giovanna and Cristiano devise a plan to make Angel confess to the crime. Araídes looks for Lara at boarding school, where she is expelled for lack of payment. Angel and Cristiano parade together.

episodes.title: Capítulo 3
episodes.summary: After they parade together, Cristiano meets Angel and tries to get closer. Percy is enchanted by Angel, who agrees to have dinner with him to get money for his son's exams.

episodes.title: Capítulo 4
episodes.summary: Angel sleeps with Percy and guarantees the money to pay for Fabricio's exams. Blanche asks Ariel out. The agency's models go to Percy and Ariel's nightclub.

episodes.title: Capítulo 5
episodes.summary: Giovanna catches Cristiano and Angel together at the club. Lara tells Araides that she wants to be a model like Angel. Blanche discovers Visky and Ariel's deal to take the models to the club.

episodes.title: Capitulo 6
episodes.summary: Ariel hides from Laila that she slept with Blanche. Cristiano confesses to Giovanna that he got involved with Angel. Blanche accepts Laila at the agency and says she needs to lose weight.

episodes.title: Capitulo 7
episodes.summary: Cristiano pressures Angel to tell the truth about Alex's death. Angel discovers that Fabricio has a serious illness. Laila begins to feel the effects of the drugs.

episodes.title: Capitulo 8
episodes.summary: Cristiano has more evidence to believe that Angel is to blame for Alex's death. Under the circumstances, he makes a decision. Fabricio starts treatment against the disease.

episodes.title: Capitulo 9
episodes.summary: Ariel discovers that Blanche gave Laila pills to lose weight. Visky suspects Cristiano. Giovanna discovers that Cristiano destroyed investigation evidence to protect Angel.

episodes.title: Capitulo 10
episodes.summary: Visky goes after him to find out who Cristiano is and Tânia agrees to spy on Giovanna. Blanche closes a deal with Lucius and gets his help to deceive Ariel

episodes.title: Capitulo 11
episodes.summary: Aware that Cristiano is an investigator, Angel is surprised by his marriage proposal. Joseph is offended by Blanche's attitude. Cristiano catches Angel's encounter with Percy.

episodes.title: Capitulo 12
episodes.summary: Angel and Percy spend the night together. Cristiano asks Giovanna to resume the investigation. Betty gathers the models in the studio to organize the mall's parade.

episodes.title: Capitulo 13
episodes.summary: Cristiano pressures the sheriff to reopen the investigation into Alex's death and tells Giovanna that he's got evidence that could incriminate Angel. The two get involved again.

episodes.title: Capitulo 14
episodes.summary: Cristiano, Edney and Euripides are looking for a witness who can incriminate Angel. Giotto catches Betty with Matheus. Giovanna and Cristiano set a trap for Benji at the club.

episodes.title: Capitulo 15
episodes.summary: Araídes takes the blame for Nicolau's death to free Lara. Under the influence of medication, Laila climbs the catwalk and Matheus parades for the first time.

episodes.title: Capitulo 16
episodes.summary: Araídes receives a visit from Lara and advises her to become a model. Laila pretends to take medication prescribed by the doctor. Benji pressures Bruno to take money from the family.

episodes.title: Capitulo 17
episodes.summary: Bruno despairs when he sees that Benji has fallen through the apartment window and asks his sister for help. Giovanna advances the evidence against Angel. Lara says goodbye to her mother and goes to São Paulo.

episodes.title: Capitulo 18
episodes.summary: Cristiano seduces Angel and the two are together. While she sleeps, he picks up strands of hair from his brush. Laila is taken to the hospital and Ariel questions Blanche about medication.

episodes.title: Capitulo 19
episodes.summary: Angel tells Percy that he feels bad about the way he loves her. Visky and Lurdeca stay. Bruno blackmails his sister and is hospitalized. Cristiano says he has evidence to put Angel in jail.

episodes.title: Capitulo 20
episodes.summary: Angel looks for Cristiano and asks him to drop the investigation. Lara tries to get to the agency to talk to Visky. Ariel takes Laila to the psychiatrist.

episodes.title: Capitulo 21
episodes.summary: Arrested, Angel receives a visit from Giovanna, who pressures her to confess to the crime. Cristiano has a crisis of conscience. At the agency, Visky confronts the investigator and introduces Lara to Blanche.

episodes.title: Capítulo 22
episodes.summary: Percy promises to help Angel in exchange for rewards and hires a lawyer to free her. Lurdeca feels uncomfortable at the agency. Lua does her first photo shoot.

episodes.title: Capítulo 23
episodes.summary: Angel is surprised by Cristiano's visit. Giovanna finds out for Edney and takes action. Later, Angel is taken to court for a hearing. Lurdeca makes a revelation.

episodes.title: Capítulo 24
episodes.summary: Visky and the gang at the agency react to Lurdeca's announcement. Cristiano tries to find Bruno in rehab. Lua gets her first job as a model. Nalva advises Angel.

episodes.title: Capítulo 25
episodes.summary: Blanche sends Angel away from the agency and Visky promises to help her get back. He turns to Percy to convince the boss. Cristiano facilitates Bruno's escape from the clinic.

episodes.title: Capítulo 26
episodes.summary: Angel accepts Cristiano's proposal to put Giovanna in jail. He promises to help her find an inheritance. Lua unburdens herself with Cristiano and Lurdeca decides to move to another city.

episodes.title: Capítulo 27
episodes.summary: Visky tells the Moon about a pink book. Giovanna looks for Percy at her house and is surprised by Angel. Laila discovers Ariel's secret and Blanche reveals to Visky Lurdeca's plan.

episodes.title: Capítulo 28
episodes.summary: Tania finds Laila and calls Ariel. Giovanna feels threatened by Cristiano. Later, the investigator has dinner with Lua, who makes an unusual request.

episodes.title: Capítulo 29
episodes.summary: Cristiano says he loves Angel and promises to help her. Visky gives instructions for Lua's pink book. Giovanna receives subpoena of justice. Ariel tries to find out who gave Laila medicine.

episodes.title: Capítulo 30
episodes.summary: Giovanna turns to Cristiano to get rid of the accusation, but discovers that he is collaborating with Bruno. Questioned by Ariel, Blanche denies having given Laila medicine. Mark catches Chiara with a pink book client.

episodes.title: Capítulo 31
episodes.summary: Giovanna is arrested for contempt of authority. Lurdeca has pregnancy desires and Visky is sensitized. Ariel says she will get revenge on whoever provided Laila with medicine. Fabricio gets worse.

episodes.title: Capítulo 32
episodes.summary: Cristiano proposes to Giovanna that he rehire him to prove Alex's death. Angel is surprised by Percy's marriage proposal. Lua is disappointed with her modeling career.

episodes.title: Capítulo 33
episodes.summary: Giovanna tells Cristiano that she's going to get the money for the investigation. Visky tells Giovanna that Percy has agreed to sponsor her show, but with one condition.

episodes.title: Capítulo 34
episodes.summary: At the engagement dinner, Percy notices atmosphere between Betty and Matheus. Cristiano and Lua talk about the night they spent together. Cristiano tries to tell Percy's secret to Angel.

episodes.title: Capítulo 35
episodes.summary: Cristiano says goodbye and leaves for Angra with Thais. They go in search of Alex's body. Angel dreads what might be found. Months pass.

episodes.title: Capítulo 36
episodes.summary: With Alex's corpse uncovered, Giovanna is in a hurry to get revenge on Angel. She and Bruno feign shock at the arrival of their father's body. And Cristiano promises to have Angel in his hands.

episodes.title: Capítulo 37
episodes.summary: Visky tells the truth about Blanche to Ariel. With the release of the forensic examination of Alex's body scheduled, Angel feels insecure. Cristiano looks for Lua.

episodes.title: Capítulo 38
episodes.summary: Giovanna is revolted by the result of the forensic examination. Angel and Percy celebrate the conclusion of the case. At the club, Ariel swears she will get revenge on Blanche.

episodes.title: Capítulo 39
episodes.summary: Angel cries in Cristiano's arms and opens up. Ariel proposes to Blanche that Percy become a partner at the agency. Fabricio's health deteriorates. Giovanna doesn't accept to see Angel free.

episodes.title: Capítulo 40
episodes.summary: Giovanna asks Cristiano to make Angel confess to Alex's murder. He is looking for a delegate to talk about his reintegration into the corporation. Blanche rethinks partnership with Percy.

episodes.title: Capítulo 41
episodes.summary: Cristiano puts into practice a plan for Angel to confess to Alex's murder. Lua finds Cristiano and they talk about the stolen watch. Cristiano proposes to Angel.

episodes.title: Capítulo 42
episodes.summary: Angel catches Cristiano and Giovanna together. Betty plans separation. Blanche makes a decision. Angel proposes a deal with Percy. Giovanna and Cristiano have an argument.

episodes.title: Capítulo 43
episodes.summary: Giovanna confronts Cristiano in order to get a recording of Angel's confession. Edney is shocked with discovery. Ariel continues her plan for revenge.

episodes.title: Capítulo 44
episodes.summary: Angel suspects that Cristiano may have a hand up against her. Giovanna plots a plan to hinder Cristiano. Igor finds Bruno unconscious.

episodes.title: Capítulo 45
episodes.summary: Giovanna blackmails Cristiano into getting Angel's recording. Angel is threatened by Lua and Thaddeus after refusing to hand over her watch. Angel responds to Cristiano's marriage proposal.

episodes.title: Capítulo 46
episodes.summary: Angel urges Percy that his trip abroad be speeded up. Giovanna offers cash for Angel's confession. Cristiano shows Angel's confession recording.

episodes.title: Capítulo 47
episodes.summary: Cristiano threatens Angel with a recording. Percy and henchmen beat up Cristiano, who promises to end up with Angel. Cristiano makes a decision.

episodes.title: Capítulo 48
episodes.summary: Ariel hires hacker to access Blanche's accounts. Bruno makes plans to escape from detox clinic. Angel visits Giovanna's apartment.

episodes.title: Capítulo 49
episodes.summary: Cristiano summons the press. Blanche discovers that Ariel has withdrawn money from her account. Bruno runs away from the clinic with an intern colleague. Visky tries to convince Cristiano to talk to Angel.

episodes.title: Final 1
episodes.summary: Angel asks Nalva to pack Faby's bags for the trip. Blanche fires Visky, who begs for her position. Bruno surprises Pia and Igor. Ariel finishes revenge plan.

episodes.title: Final 2
episodes.summary: Different ending from 50m06s. Angel asks Nalva to pack Faby's bags for the trip. Blanche fires Visky, who begs for her position. Bruno surprises Pia and Igor. Ariel finishes revenge plan.
